description: This file defines a validation rule class 'EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule' within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for validating read permissions on employee data groups in the attendance plugin's API validation rules. It checks user permissions and throws an exception if access is denied.

classes.name: EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule
classes.description: A validation rule class for checking user permissions to read data from employee data groups within the attendance plugin API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the data group name for permission validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the permission check; throws ForbiddenException if the user does not have read access.
